stem.text: The diagram shows a string stretched between fixed points X and Y. There is a stationary wave on the string.

stem.alt: Stationary wave on a string between fixed points X and Y, with a solid curve and a dashed curve showing two extreme positions; labelled points S, P, Q, R and T on the string.

stem.text: The solid curve shows the string at a position of maximum displacement at time $t_0$. The dashed curve shows the other position of maximum displacement. The straight central dashed line shows the mean position of the string.
Point S on the string is directly above point P. Point T on the string is directly below point Q.

A.text: A short time after $t_0$, point R on the string will be displaced.

B.text: A short time after $t_0$, points S and T on the string move in opposite directions.

C.text: The distance between P and Q is one wavelength.

D.text: Two moving points on the string that are equal distances from point R vibrate in phase.
